bonuses.name: Whirling Death & Howling Banshee Mask
bonuses.text: Howling Banshees gain an additional +2 bonus dice on melee attacks made as part of a Charge (+3 bonus dice in total). Additionally, a Howling Banshee may make an Intimidation Interaction Attack as a Free Action as part of a Charge.

bonuses.name: Intense Emotions
bonuses.text: This Threat takes a penalty of +1 DN to all Resolve Tests.

options.name: Howling Banshee Exarch
options.text: A Howling Banshee Exarch has Weapon Skill 11 and 9 Wounds. They loses their Banshee Blade, and gain the equipment and bonuses below: Executioner: 9 +5 ED / AP -3 / Parry; Champion: An Exarch may use Ruin Actions; Nerve-Shredding Shriek: Howling Banshees can emit a horrible shriek that leaves their foes reeling. When within 10m of their Exarch they may spend Shifts on Intimidate Interaction Attacks to inflict 1 Mortal Wound on the target.
